title: Sura
description: Korean poet Baek Seok once used a spider as a metaphor for family. Hae-Ji Jeong draws on the poem’s meanings and explores the feelings of a college student who is dealing with her friend’s abortion. She delicately exposes how issues of shame and vulnerability affect women in Korean society.
producers: Hae-Ji Jeong Screening at over 40 festivals around the world
this intriguing short has a simple premise
but is anything but. As colourful as it is obscure
the film is nonetheless a masterclass in animation technique
like breaking through the melancholia felt when waking from a dream.
